import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { address } from "./address";
import { store } from "./store";
import { payment } from "./payment";
import { rental } from "./rental";

export const staff = defineTable("staff", {
    columns: {
        staffId: col.serial().primaryKey(),
        firstName: col.text().notNull(),
        lastName: col.text().notNull(),
        addressId: col.integer().notNull(),
        email: col.text(),
        storeId: col.integer().notNull(),
        active: col.boolean().notNull().default(true),
        username: col.text().notNull(),
        password: col.text(),
        lastUpdate: col.timestamptz().notNull().onCreateNow(),
        picture: col.bytea()
    },
    relations: {
        address: rel.belongsTo(() => address),
        store: rel.belongsTo(() => store, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        payment: rel.hasMany(() => payment),
        rental: rel.hasMany(() => rental)
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
